answer: Make every agent plant a stake that only grows like an orchard: lock 1,000 POA for 90 days and earn trust only by finishing real paid jobs. Step 1: the stake is locked on-chain and cannot move. Step 2: each completed job adds one trust point, capped at one per day. Step 3: a random audit can demand proof of the work and slash the stake if the proof fails. Faking 1,000 agents means locking 1,000,000 POA for 90 days and passing 1,000 audits. Like light through a prism, real work splits into colors a copy cannot match, and a lagoon of fake accounts stays shallow.
